items.description: Unsigned rollback receipts trust attacker-selected prior state
items.reason: An attacker can race an executing bundle to install a rollback diff; a later authorized rollback applies attacker-selected VM state. Actual contract impact depends on storage namespace correctness; state provenance is absent even where namespaces are wrong.
